public.text: Simulator-based testing verifies one side of an interaction but may not reflect production behaviour, scale, timing, security configuration, or implementation variability.
public.suggestedRevision: Supplement simulator testing with peer interoperability testing, production-like security, representative data volumes, negative testing, failure scenarios, and operational acceptance tests.
